The element livermorium, Lv, was discovered in the year 2000.
Which statement predicts what will happen to an Lv atom when it forms an Lv2– ion?
A
The atom will gain two electrons.
B
The atom will lose two electrons.
C
The atom will lose two protons.
D
The atom will gain two protons.

options.label: A
options.text: The atom will gain two electrons.

options.label: B
options.text: The atom will lose two electrons.

options.label: C
options.text: The atom will lose two protons.

options.label: D
options.text: The atom will gain two protons.
